data.name: Hotel Monarca
data.address: Av. Álvaro Obregón 32, Roma Nte., Cuauhtémoc, 06700 Ciudad de México, CDMX, Mexico
data.description:
Off of Álvaro Obregón Avenue and a block from the Pushkin Garden, this relaxed hotel is an 8-minute walk from the Niños Heroes metro station and 5 km from the National Museum of Anthropology.
The casual, straightforward rooms are equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and DVD players, in addition to en suite bathrooms.
Covered parking is available.
